data.long_meaning: Aaliyah (עֲלִיָּה) is a name of Arabic / Hebrew origin meaning “Rising; ascending; exalted”. From Arabic عالية (ʿāliyah) 'high, exalted, sublime', from the root ع-ل-و (ʿ-l-w) 'to be high'. A homophonous Hebrew word עֲלִיָּה (ʿaliyyah) means 'ascent' (as in immigration to Israel). The two are distinct in origin. Its root is Arabic عالية (ʿāliyah) 'high, exalted', from the root ع-ل-و (ʿ-l-w) 'to be high'; also Hebrew עֲלִיָּה (ʿaliyyah) 'ascent'. Aaliyah is an Arabic name; it is not a Biblical or Christian name in origin. It is distinct from Hebrew עֲלִיָּה (ʿaliyyah) 'ascent' - a distinct word, not the same name.
